name: Waning Basecradle
description: Chalk the seam of the target wall and sight the arm's line onto its weakest course of stone.

name: Skeinlinctus
description: Tally each shot against the chalk mark so every stone strikes within a hand's reach of the last.

name: Chime Throwarm
description: Knock stones together and keep only those that ring clear and will not shatter on impact.

name: Aegis Armcup
description: Brace the hip against the frame beam during a heavy draw so the crew keeps its footing.

name: Rumble Frameside
description: Drive a qi-hardened stone at one course of the wall to crack the mortar and loosen the facing.

name: Grinding Releasepin
description: Loose stone after stone at the cracked course so each blow lands in the wound of the last.

name: Torqueassault
description: Hurl a heavy qi-wrapped stone that drives through a cracked facing and shakes the fill behind it.

name: Drubbing Arcflight
description: Draw the skeins to full and cast one stone that brings down the loosened course in a heap.

name: Renewing Winchdrum
description: Read the steep angle of the arm at its stop and see how it lifts a stone over a tall obstacle.

name: Rejuvenating Axlepin
description: Mark the height of the works on a stake so the arc is set to clear it with room to spare.

name: Anointing Skein
description: Raise the rear of the bed on pegs by notched steps to lift the arc one notch at a time.

name: Intent Stoneload
description: Tie a cord from arm to frame to shorten the arm's rise and keep the throw high and short.

name: Chime Torsion
description: Wrap the stone in qi and loft it high so it clears the works and falls steeply behind them.

name: Tearing Stonefall
description: Walk a line of stones over the works by small bed changes so each falls a pace beyond the last.

name: Hoarfrost Axlepin
description: Hold a flat qi sheet over the crew's heads while stones from the far side drop near the frame.

name: Needling Rumble Throwarm
description: Throw a heavy stone so high that it plunges nearly straight down onto the roofs behind the works.

name: Scything Bombardment
description: Cast a wide qi-bound load that bursts at the top of the arc and rains stones across an enclosed yard.

name: Vitalarmcup
description: Work tallow into every strand of the great skein with a long paddle before the season's first draw.

name: Winchremedy
description: Probe the crossbeam seams with a thin iron rod to find rot that a mallet would miss.

name: Restoring Skein
description: Call the pace for twelve hands at the great windlass so they turn the drum as one body.

name: Facetwinch
description: Drop the pawl chain over the great ratchet and test its hold with a measured jerk.

name: Intentskein
description: Walk a stone of a man's weight up a plank slope and tip it into the great cup.

name: Nova Basecradle
description: Extend a field of qi along the skeins as twelve hands draw the arm to ease the strain on the frame.

name: Blaze Ballistic
description: Free the arm at the instant the skeins quiver at full twist so the throw leaves with all their energy.

name: Immovable Frameside
description: Send a field of qi through the frame at release to calm the shudder that would crack its joints.

name: Lancing Ballistic
description: Charge the stone with the qi field and hurl it so the great arm's throw punches through heavy timber.

name: Blazetorque
description: Draw the great engine to its last tooth and loose a stone whose landing shakes the ground around it.

name: Anointing Stoneload
description: Seal a clay jar of pitch with waxed cloth and bind it in netting so it survives the cup.

name: Facetarmcup
description: Line the cup with wet hide so the flames of a lit shot do not scorch the pouch.

name: Might Armcup
description: Soak the lighting cord in oil and cut it to the length of the arm's swing.

name: Chime Winchdrum
description: Post the crew upwind of the frame so the smoke of a lit shot never blows back at them.

name: Nova Unwind
description: Light the wrapped shot and loft it with qi so the flame survives the throw and lands burning.

name: Needling Torsion
description: Time the burst of the jar at the end of its arc with a nip of qi so the pitch splashes wide.

name: Blazearmcup
description: Throw a cluster of jars that burst together and join their pitch into one sheet of flame.

name: Glamour Stonefall
description: Lob smoking shot in a line so the drifting smoke hides the crew and blinds the enemy's aim.

name: Daybreak Winchdrum
description: Two winders work opposed cranks in matched turns so the twin skeins draw to the same degree.

name: Chime Armcup
description: Tap both skein bundles with one mallet and compare their notes until the pair rings alike.

name: Silt Arcflight
description: Walk the crew in two columns that mirror each other from the stone pile to the cup.

name: Winchhauberk
description: Drop the left and right pawls together on one command so the arm is held by both.

name: Chime Bombardment
description: Feed qi into both skeins in equal measure so the arm leaves on a throw both sides share.

name: Rumbleunwind
description: Two pullers loose their lanyards on a single call so the catch opens on both sides at once.

name: Hoarfrost Releasepin
description: Settle qi into the left and right frame beams in turn until the whole bed stands even.

name: Torquethrash
description: Throw two stones from one cup on two linked arcs that cross and fall on the mark together.

name: Forged Throwarm
description: Loose two frames on one count at the same point so the second stone finishes what the first began.

name: Equipoise Torsion
description: Plant the feet wide and stoop slightly like a hawk before a dive so the draw comes from the legs.

name: Frameside Remedy
description: Sight the target from a raised post above the frame and call the correction down to the crew.

name: Waningarmcup
description: Read the clarity of the air and the set of the clouds to judge how far a stone will carry.

name: Heartening Releasepin
description: Listen for the draft that rises along the basin sides and note how it nudges a falling stone.

name: Might Unwind
description: Pace a measuring line along the riverbank from frame to target so the range is read in even steps.

name: Heartening Axlepin
description: Tie the sling pouch in the wing fold of the school so it opens as one piece at release.

name: Transfixing Skein
description: Loose a stone on a falling line that stoops onto the target like a hawk onto its mark.

name: Vigorous Winchdrum
description: Watch the shot through two sighting posts at once and correct the next draw where they disagree.

name: Rumbleskein
description: Spread a field of qi under the stone's flight so its long arc holds true across a shifting wind.

name: Facet Torque
description: Throw a heavy qi-wound stone that climbs high and drops straight onto its mark in a hawk's dive.

name: Harrowing Torque
description: Cast two stones by two tracks of qi so that one lands as a feint and the other as the true blow.

name: Remnant Torsion
description: Choose smooth river stones of matched weight from the shallows and carry them in pairs to the frame.

name: Nursing Armcup
description: Level the basin floor under the frame bed with paired wooden rammers worked in alternate strokes.

name: Winchlinctus
description: Run two ranging cords from frame to target at slightly different angles and read where they cross.

name: Chime Stoneload
description: Allow for the wet air rising off the river by shortening the draw by one tooth.

name: Facetskein
description: Loose a stone across the river to land on the far bank where the paired crew marked the ground.

name: Winchelixir
description: Hold a thread of qi on the stone in flight and correct its drift from the river wind.

name: Severing Ballistic
description: Cast a spread of heavy stones at a ford so the crossing is churned and choked with rubble.

name: Glint Arcflight
description: Loose two heavy stones in a measured pair so the first splits a moored boat and the second sinks it.

name: Vital Basecradle
description: Swear the crew to its posts aloud and set each hand beside the frame before the first draw.

name: Armcupplating
description: Set the wheels of the frame well back from the plateau edge and chock them against the wind.

name: Clear Releasepin
description: Take the bearing with a cord and a bone sight and hold it by marks scratched on the frame.

name: Steady Stoneload
description: Watch a strip of cloth on the frame post to read each gust before the arm is freed.

name: Throwarm Linctus
description: Walk the loading round in a circle on open ground with each stone passed from hand to hand.

name: Nova Bombardment
description: Lean the aim into the crosswind and loose so the stone is carried back onto the bearing.

name: Glinttorque
description: Hold the breath through a gust and free the arm in the lull so the throw flies even.

name: Might Frameside
description: Wind the crank to the spoken beat of the oath so the whole crew draws in the same instant.

name: Skinning Torque
description: Throw a qi-wound stone downwind across the plateau so it carries farther than a plain throw could.

name: Daybreak Ballistic
description: Hold one bearing through a long cast and loose a spread of stones that falls on the marked ground.

name: Sustaining Axlepin
description: Scratch the sworn bearing on the frame beam so every hand sees the line the shot must hold.

name: Stonefall Sprint
description: Stand on the windward side of the frame so the swinging arm never throws dust into the eyes.

name: Nursing Basecradle
description: Call the count of the draw aloud as an oath so no hand lets the rope slip.

name: Restoring Releasepin
description: Wipe the cup lip dry of dew so the stone sits true in the morning wind.

name: Novaskein
description: Fix the eye on the bearing and loft the stone on the line the oath laid down.

name: Waningwinch
description: Turn the bed a finger's breadth with each shift of the wind to keep the bearing true.

name: Nursing Torsion
description: Draw the arm on one long held breath and keep the frame steady through the whole winding.

name: Ironwinch
description: Loose a heavy stone along the bearing so hard that it splits a laid line of shields.

name: Slagtorque
description: Cast a load that the wind spreads wide across the field so no crossing is safe.

name: Daybreak Basecradle
description: Place the frame where a rise of ground gives the arm a clear throw in every direction.

name: Chimewinch
description: Read the swing of a wind sock tied to the frame post and mark each gust on a board.

name: Surging Stonefall
description: Pace out the rise of the ground before the frame so every shot clears it without a hit.

name: Silt Skein
description: Turn a frame mounted on a cart by hauling its trail ropes and leaning the wheels into the wind.

name: Equipoise Axlepin
description: Pile throwing stones in three caches around the frame so the loader never crosses the arm's sweep.

name: Thorn Armcup
description: Bind cloth over the skein bundle in a gale so rain and blown grit cannot get under the twist.

name: Remnant Frameside
description: Stretch a thin field of qi across the open ground to feel the edge of an approaching rush.

name: Rupturing Arcflight
description: Loose the stone as a gust passes so the wind itself lifts it farther than the arm alone could.

name: Nova Torque
description: Lead a moving formation by the width of its stride and loose so the stone arrives as it crosses.

name: Rousing Throwarm
description: Hold a sworn breath as the arm is drawn so qi and crew effort come together on the last tooth.

name: Unwind Thrash
description: Cast a great load across open ground so it falls among a loose line and breaks its order.

name: Tearing Bombardment
description: Loose a stone on a wind-driven low line that punches through the shields of an advancing front.
